MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which sentence means "This is my older sister."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是我爸爸。
   B. 那是我弟弟。
   C. 这是我姐姐。
   D. 我爱你。

2. What does 爱 (ài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Love
   B. Is, am, are
   C. Mother
   D. Younger brother

3. What does 东西放好 mean? (1 mark)
   A. Put things away well
   B. Sit down
   C. Come here
   D. Wash hands

4. Fill the blank: 厨房里有____。 (There is a fridge in the kitchen.) (1 mark)
   A. 冰箱
   B. 电视
   C. 床
   D. 沙发

5. Which character is the number five? (1 mark)
   A. 三
   B. 五
   C. 九
   D. 七

6. Which sentence means "On Sunday, go to church."? (1 mark)
   A. 明天是星期四。
   B. 我星期六在家休息。
   C. 星期天,去教堂。
   D. 今天星期三。

7. What does 我们 (wǒmen) mean? (1 mark)
   A. We
   B. Everybody
   C. Candle
   D. They

8. Which sentence means "When is your birthday?"? (1 mark)
   A. 我们切蛋糕。
   B. 朋友送我礼物。
   C. 你生日是几月几号?
   D. 我们唱歌。

9. Read the pinyin: zhè shì shénme? What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. I drink tea.
   B. What is this?
   C. I like to eat bananas.
   D. For breakfast I eat bǐng.

10. What does 鸡肉 (jīròu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Apple
   B. Chicken (meat)
   C. Fruit (as a group)
   D. Grapes

11. What does 脚 (jiǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To use
   B. Shoulder
   C. Head
   D. Foot

12. Which Chinese word means "ear"? (1 mark)
   A. 刷牙 shuāyá
   B. 耳朵 ěrduo
   C. 牙 yá
   D. 看 kàn

13. Fill the blank: 今天____雨。 (Today it rains.) (1 mark)
   A. 在
   B. 上
   C. 好
   D. 下

14. Read the pinyin: zhè shì tàiyáng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today there are clouds.
   B. The wind is very strong.
   C. The rain is heavy.
   D. This is the sun.

15. What does 花园 (huāyuán) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Garden
   B. Beside
   C. Living room
   D. Sofa

16. What does 里 (lǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To put
   B. Door
   C. Inside
   D. Bathroom

17. Which Chinese word means "hello"? (1 mark)
   A. 叫 jiào
   B. 你好 nǐ hǎo
   C. 再见 zàijiàn
   D. 老师 lǎoshī

18. How many strokes does the character 十 have? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 4
   C. 1
   D. 2

19. What does 妈妈 (māma) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mother
   B. Younger brother
   C. Father
   D. Younger sister

20. What does 这 (zhè) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Is, am, are
   B. Younger brother
   C. This
   D. Older sister

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 椅子 and 谁. (2 marks)

22. Explain what tone, volume and vocal projection mean when reading aloud. (3 marks)

23. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Where is the television?" (2 marks)

24. Explain how you can guess the meaning of 咖啡 in 我喝咖啡. (3 marks)

25. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 学校 and 看. (2 marks)

26. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: nà shì wǒ dìdi. (2 marks)

27. Explain what the part 女 tells us in 妈, 姐 and 妹. (3 marks)

28. Explain one way each of these family members might help you: 妈妈 and 哥哥. Then say one way you help them. (4 marks)

29. Write a short paragraph in Chinese with pinyin that says there are four people in your family and names three of them. (5 marks)

30. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 风 and 鸡肉. (2 marks)

31. Tell how to tell 大 dà from 太 tài by looking. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — 这是我姐姐。
   这是我姐姐。 (zhè shì wǒ jiějie.) means "This is my older sister.".

2. A — Love
   爱 (ài) means love.

3. A — Put things away well
   东西 is things and 放好 is put away well.

4. A — 冰箱
   The fridge is in the kitchen.

5. B — 五
   五 wǔ is five.

6. C — 星期天,去教堂。
   星期天,去教堂。 (xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng.) means "On Sunday, go to church.".

7. A — We
   我们 (wǒmen) means we.

8. C — 你生日是几月几号?
   你生日是几月几号? (nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?) means "When is your birthday?".

9. B — What is this?
   zhè shì shénme? is 这是什么?, which means "What is this?".

10. B — Chicken (meat)
   鸡肉 (jīròu) means chicken (meat).

11. D — Foot
   脚 (jiǎo) means foot.

12. B — 耳朵 ěrduo
   耳朵 (ěrduo) means ear.

13. D — 下
   下雨 means it rains.

14. D — This is the sun.
   zhè shì tàiyáng. is 这是太阳。, which means "This is the sun.".

15. A — Garden
   花园 (huāyuán) means garden.

16. C — Inside
   里 (lǐ) means inside.

17. B — 你好 nǐ hǎo
   你好 (nǐ hǎo) means hello.

18. D — 2
   十 has 横 and 竖.

19. A — Mother
   妈妈 (māma) means mother.

20. C — This
   这 (zhè) means this.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: 椅子: yǐzi, chair. 谁: shéi, who.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tone is the rise and fall of each syllable, volume is how loud you speak and projection is sending your voice to the back of the room without shouting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: 电视在哪儿? diànshì zài nǎr?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: The verb 喝 means to drink, so 咖啡 must be a drink. A picture can also help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the verb clue, 1 mark for the conclusion, 1 mark for another clue.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: 学校: xuéxiào, school. 看: kàn, to look, to see.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: That is my younger brother.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: 女 means woman or female, so the characters are for female family members.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the link to family, 1 mark for naming the three characters.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: mum cooks and cares for us; an older brother helps with homework; I help by washing the dishes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each helper, 1 mark for how, 1 mark for your own help. Any sensible answer.

29. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我家有四口人。这是我爸爸,这是我妈妈,这是我。 wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén. zhè shì wǒ bàba, zhè shì wǒ māma, zhè shì wǒ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the family size sentence, 2 marks for three correct sentences, 1 mark for pinyin, 1 mark for punctuation.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风: fēng, wind. 鸡肉: jīròu, chicken (meat).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: 太 has an extra dot at the bottom right.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the dot and 1 mark for naming the two characters correctly.
